description: Auto-fit responsive grid: as many columns as fit the minimum width, then wrap. Attribute form: data-layout="grid".

attributes.name: data-layout-min
attributes.description: Minimum column width before wrapping: 8 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 25rem. Tracks are clamped to the container (min(…, 100%)), so a grid narrower than the minimum shows one full-width column instead of overflowing. One-off lengths: style="--layout-min: 220px" (not inherited by nested grids).

attributes.name: data-layout-gap
attributes.description: Gap between cells, on the shared size scale.

attributes.name: data-layout-subgrid
attributes.description: Each child becomes a subgrid spanning 2, 3 or 4 rows (bare = 3; any other value also spans 3) so header/content/footer line up across siblings. The subgridded rows use the grid's row gap, so data-layout-gap also spaces the parts inside each child — set row-gap on the children to override.
